## Type of change

## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (lint, types, tests, security scan)
- [ ] New or changed MCP tools have tests (success, denial and validation paths)
- [ ] Platform endpoints/permissions are cited from official documentation in the code or docs
- [ ] No credentials, tokens or real account data in code, tests or fixtures
- [ ] External writes go through `Runtime.execute` (approval, audit, rate limits)
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG updated
